note: Historical third-party-dependency trust-boundary measurement (paragon axis 1: 'every dependency verified, continuously gated'). `cargo deny check` remains wired into scripts/local_gate.sh FULL mode. This 2026-06-30 result predates AY's migration from sibling paths to one immutable Git source and is not evidence for the current graph. deny.toml now allow-lists crates.io, carcara, and first-party AY; rerun cargo-deny and replace this measurement before making a current GREEN claim.
overall_summary: Historical result only: advisories ok, bans ok, licenses ok, sources ok (exit 0) on the pre-AY-Git graph.
lock_drift_note: Historical note: this run measured the former ../ay path-dependency graph. The current committed Cargo.lock contains immutable AY Git sources and has not yet been measured by this snapshot.

advisories.detail: Zero RustSec vulnerabilities in the resolved graph. The single warning is `advisory-not-detected` for RUSTSEC-2026-0002 (lru IterMut unsoundness): lru is now resolved at 0.18.0 (well past the 0.13 fix), so that ignore entry in deny.toml is now STALE/dead and can be removed on a future deny.toml cleanup. The other two ignores (RUSTSEC-2025-0141 bincode-unmaintained, RUSTSEC-2024-0436 paste-unmaintained) remain matched-and-suppressed with documented rationale; mirrored in .cargo/audit.toml.

licenses.detail: Every resolved crate's license is in the allow-list (Apache-2.0/MIT/BSD/ISC/Zlib/MPL-2.0/Unicode/CDLA/CC0) or covered by a documented per-crate exception (gmp-mpfr-sys, rug LGPL-3.0; ring ISC AND MIT AND OpenSSL clarify). The 5 warnings are pure hygiene over-provisioning: 3 `license-not-encountered` (BSD-3-Clause, CDLA-Permissive-2.0, Unicode-DFS-2016 allowed but no current crate uses them) + 2 `license-exception-not-encountered` (gmp-mpfr-sys, rug exceptions not currently in the macOS-resolved graph — they ride via the ../ay LRA stack which is feature-gated). No license violations.

bans.detail: No banned crate (openssl-sys, openssl, native-tls — the rustls-only policy) is present in the graph. The 19 warnings are all `duplicate` (multiple-versions = 'warn' by deny.toml policy, not 'deny'): bitflags, block-buffer, constant_time_eq, cpufeatures, crypto-common, dashmap, digest, foldhash, getrandom (x3), hashbrown (x3), rand, rand_chacha, rand_core, sha2, shlex, toml, toml_datetime, unicode-width, winnow. These are benign semver-major coexistence across transitive deps; no skip entries needed under the warn policy.

sources.detail: Historical pre-migration result: every measured source was crates.io or the allow-listed carcara Git revision. The current graph additionally contains immutable first-party AY Git sources; deny.toml permits that exact repository, but this snapshot does not claim a measured source verdict for it.
